scope.behavior: supervised promoter-logit margin on fresh exact-GUE-excluded GENCODE MANE TSS versus same-locus pseudo-TSS pairs
scope.mechanistic_candidate: replicated D7 L11H2/L11H5 value-payload alignment dependence
scope.strategy_1: unbiased equal-dose 10-nt nominal tile atlas using two BPE tokens per target and control sequence
scope.strategy_2: independent biological qualification with FANTOM5 CAGE, ENCODE PLS cCREs, UCSC CpG islands, and predefined EPD promoter motifs
scope.licensed_if_qualified: a classifier-relevant TSS-relative source region and/or a source region for the replicated late-pair V payload, with separately stated overlap or motif-disruption evidence
explicitly_excluded: mediation between a nucleotide motif and L11H2/L11H5
a claim that attention identifies a biological feature
exact 10-nt resolution when the selected BPE cover extends beyond the nominal tile

frozen_basis.threshold_basis: A disjoint 16-pair reserved-GUE slice gave 9.54e-7 maximum identity error, 0.463-logit mean absolute equal-dose mask effect, 0.00553 all-layer-11 regional-V mean absolute effect, and a projected 0.00297-logit 80% MDE for the candidate regional-V endpoint at the minimum target tile supply. The mask endpoint is heterogeneous (worst projected MDE 0.507), so a positive confidence bound is mandatory and small mask effects are not interpreted.

tile_geometry.token_choice: adjacent genomic BPE-token pair maximizing nucleotide overlap with the nominal tile, then minimizing center distance, cover length, and start coordinate
tile_geometry.precision_boundary: Every result reports the nominal tile and actual target/control BPE covers. A qualified tile is not an exact 10-nt motif call.

interventions.mask: replace the two selected post-tokenization genomic token IDs by the tokenizer's [MASK] ID; no retokenization
interventions.candidate_value_swap: swap the two selected V vectors separately within each sequence for L11H2/L11H5 while leaving Q, K, QK logits, ALiBi, and native attention probabilities unchanged
interventions.regional_head_nulls: all 45 candidate-excluding two-head pairs in layer 11 with the identical token region and V swap
interventions.motif_disruption: target and pseudo-TSS local shuffles preserve each branch's mononucleotide composition and use the same Hamming dose; the target EPD call must fall below cutoff, the control must remain call-negative, full BPE offsets must be unchanged, and token IDs outside the affected cover must be unchanged

measurement.target_loss: native target margin minus intervened target margin
measurement.control_loss: native pseudo-TSS margin minus intervened pseudo-TSS margin
measurement.localization_contrast: each locus/tile target-specific loss minus that locus's mean target-specific loss across its other eligible equal-dose tiles
measurement.alternative: one-sided positive: the intervention must reduce the real-TSS promoter margin more than the matched pseudo-TSS margin
measurement.value_role: source-region test for the replicated D7 value-payload association
measurement.concordance_role: mask and value qualification at the same tile is convergent localization, not mediation

primary_gates.familywise_inference: 9999 deterministic locus-level sign flips; maximum positive localization contrast across all 30 tiles and both primary operations
primary_gates.value_pair_specificity: candidate absolute raw mean must exceed all 45 same-tile candidate-excluding layer-11 pair means

biological_qualification.regional_annotation_rule: For a development-nominated tile, estimate the frozen target-specific endpoint within tile-locus observations directly overlapping each independent annotation. Preserve the unannotated estimate as a heterogeneity diagnostic; overlap is not feature specificity.
biological_qualification.regional_annotation_gate: annotated-subset mean meets the operation SESOI and its 95% locus-bootstrap lower bound exceeds zero
biological_qualification.regional_multiple_testing: maximum sign-flip correction across all powered nominated-tile by annotation combinations

motifs.multiple_testing: Holm across powered motifs overlapping development-nominated tiles
motifs.low_supply_policy: run and report continuously, but do not qualify or open confirmation

development_requires: matching frozen config and qualified reserved-GUE preflight
identity, sensitivity, geometry, batch, and null-resolution checks
clean promoter target-minus-control margin at least 0.50 logits with positive 95% lower bound
split_gate.confirmation_opens_if: at least one mask or candidate-value tile qualifies in development
split_gate.confirmation_uses: only unchanged development-nominated tiles, operations, thresholds, annotations, motifs, and null families

mechanistic_boundary: [MASK] is a synthetic model intervention and is used only for unbiased localization.
A regional V swap leaves attention probabilities native but changes which source-state value is associated with each of two addressed positions.
Annotation overlap shows biological concordance, not that the model encodes the annotation.
A motif shuffle is sequence-specific necessity evidence for the classifier margin, not evidence that L11H2/L11H5 mediates that motif.
Mediation requires a later frozen mask-or-motif by payload interaction or rescue experiment.
